name: home - ui - chart (customized to my needs)

rules.to: 'from(bucket: "'&msg.bucket&'")	  |> range(start: -1d, stop:now())	  |> aggregateWindow(every: 60s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)	  |> filter(fn: (r) =>	    r._measurement == "temperature"	  )'
'from(bucket: "'&msg.bucket&'")	  |> range(start: -1d, stop:now())	  |> aggregateWindow(every: 60s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)	  |> filter(fn: (r) =>	    r._measurement == "humidity"	  )'

'from(bucket: "'&msg.bucket&'")	  |> range(start: -1d, stop:now())	  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)	  |> filter(fn: (r) =>	    r._measurement == "'&msg.measurement&'" and r._field == "'&msg.field&'"	  )'

name: "home" is a reserved word for room and bucket
